about_the_game:
NOTICE:

The game is still in development, with a demo releasing on March 26th. When this demo comes out, if this game interests you and you try it, ANY advice, positive or negative, will be greatly appreciated!

BE THE BAD GUY WHO SAVES EVERYONE

Purgatory is where everybody goes after death. And if you commit a single, just one, unkind act in life, you're stuck there, in a hellish, dystopian afterlife where the bad guys rule with an unyielding, unforgiving fist. Doesn't sound fair, does it? With the help of a Purgatory employee, defy the fate in store for you, take on the god of everything and save the billions of victims of her cruel judgement...

...Why you? Why do you specifically have to be the one to save everyone? Oh well, it's simple really.

...You were the worst person to ever live.

Purgatory presents a lore-rich world and characters, an ever-changing and diverse environment, and a handful of memorable allies against the equally-memorable (and lovable in their own ways) forces of evil.

THE GAMEPLAY YOU KNOW AND LOVE

Using a semi-linear world design, solve puzzles, meet the citizens of Purgatory's Regions, backtrack, maybe even destroy some things in that gorgeous 16-bit pixel art style, and every now and then, some new mechanics could get involved, to keep you on your toes.

Oh, and enemies too, obviously. With a single-player point of view against groups of enemies, dodge bullets, use abilities, and keep that HP up in the bullet-hell gameplay style that makes winning feel like you earned it, and losing like you deserved it.

Wait, what does that say two paragraphs up, 'Regions?' What're those? Purgatory's divided into 5 main sections, as well a Prologue and Epilogue. The Regions, each riddled with another kind of devilish sin, are all unique and bring their own atmosphere to the party, as well as all naturally having their own plot lines within that serve towards that main goal: defeat the leader of Reality and save everyone from her dystopian regime.

OKAY, BUT DOES IT LOOK NICE?

Every wall, every plant pot, every person you meet, every single thing you see was hand-drawn with pixels to create a heavy sense of atmosphere and immersion, whether it's when you're roaming the Kafkaesque halls of Purgatory's offices; an endless, lonely field; the scorched plains of a fiery hellscape; or the seedy back alleys of a vibrant, neon-smothered metropolis.

Pixel art not enough? Numerous backgrounds for battles and menus, and graphics for key story moments have been fully hand-illustrated in glorious HD, as well as a wide range of expressive and emotive character art during dialogue.

FEATURES:

  • A story that (I think) you won't possibly be able to forget, with bad guys, good guys, and bad guys turned good guys.

  • A battle system featuring bullet hell-style gameplay, utilising a variety of different stats and your equipment, made famous by the likes of 'UNDERTALE'.

  • Story protagonists and antagonists alike who are so emotive and in-depth, you might forget they're not real!

  • Except you. Your character doesn't say much.

  • A super chipper sidekick who seems like she just helps you at the start but is also really super important, because of course there is.

  • An episodic approach to the story, with each 'Act' bringing its own hellish atmosphere and sub-story to the table.

  • Tons and tons of lore if you want to know that much about the world and its characters, but you don't need to bother if you don't want to!! Lore for everyone!!! Yay!

  • Almost entirely made by one person, who's also writing this.

  • A varied collection of side quests, each having their own approaches and endings (Maybe these matter to the main story?...).

  • A completely original soundtrack, it sounds okay I think.

  • HD, human-made art for character portraits, backgrounds and more!

  • Weird freaks that will say things when you interact with them!

  • Weird freaks! Weird freaks!!!

short_description: An indie RPG set in the afterlife, through a partly-dystopian, partly-vibrant, and always-dangerous lens. Explore a range of different environments, battle a wide range of enemies, learn an unnecessary amount of lore if you want, and most importantly... Be the bad guy who saves everyone.
